# LinkedIn Company Posts (basic) API

Post text and link only. No engagement counts, author details, media, or reaction breakdown - for those use linkedin.company_posts.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/linkedin/company-posts-thin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url": "https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. A lookup that finds nothing still succeeds and returns `found: false`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | Yes | Full LinkedIn company page URL. |
| `page` | integer | No | Page number for pagination. |

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, usually $0.0012 per request. A call can cost more when the first data source fails and another one answers. Failed calls are not charged. Lookups that find nothing and searches with no results are billed at their actual cost, which is often lower and can be $0.
